stages.hint: Win the wild horse's trust (walk to it, F, three times)

told: Discovered: A living beast's back. a beast the size of a hill, a whole camp built on its back, walking its slow round
A horse breaker:  "There's a wild horse running here. Earn its trust: come to it slowly, three times."  (quest: Tame a mount)
The horse lets you near and eats from your hand (1 of 3)
The horse lets you near and eats from your hand (2 of 3)

stages.hint: Find the ruin on the map

told: Discovered: A titan's carcass. the ribs of something vast, a fallen giant's head turned to stone beside them
A scholar:  "I have half a burned map of a ruin near here. Find it, and survive what's inside."  (quest: The lost ruin)
The half-burned map: it shows ruins and a road (1 of 1)
Discovered: Ruins of Windstead. Aqueduct: the arches of an aqueduct that outlasted the city it fed

stages.hint: Make your way back to a town

told: Discovered: A cave system. a cave's mouth in the rock, its passages running back into the dark
A ferryman:  "Cross with me to the far bank? ... The ferry! It's breaking up!"  (quest: Stranded)
